baseline: Same baseline as gap-coasts:tc-4 (out/three-coasts-epeshu.json dm_art_placements boxes used verbatim; print water mask rebuilt by the identical buildCityMask port). These numbers are NOT comparable with, and must NOT be averaged with, the tie-table (reg) figures.
key_distinction: REGISTRATION: every number here is about where the chart sits (placement scale and centre) relative to the sim's hand-placed labels, the sim disc and the print coast. RENDERING MEDIUM: a vector chart placed in the same box gives identical numbers. Only extent and hand-placed labels are compared; the sim's invented streets (planStreetsFor) are not inputs and are not to be dragged along.

method.sim_frame: index.html buildEpeshuMapData: Epēshu gridX 169 gridZ 168, cityLabels as metre offsets dx,dz from s.x,s.z (genSettlements custom branch: x=gridToWorld(gridX)); extraLandmarks via gridToWorld(gridX/gridZ). gridToWorld(i)=(i/(N-1)-0.5)*W_SIZE, N=768, W_SIZE=9000. World to atlas by sim:S1 (vertex convention): atlasX=1060+gx*800/768, gx=(x/9000+0.5)*767. m per atlas px = 9000/(767*800/768) = 11.2647 (S8 used 11.25; differences <=0.2%).
method.sim_disc: genSettlements custom branch: rad = 265 m for capital -> R = 23.52 atlas px. buildTownWall: wallR = clamp(maxD+18, s.R*0.5, s.R*1.08) -> wall band 11.76..25.41 atlas px (runtime value not measured; static only).
method.chart_projection: worldPOICoord: x0+(p.x/poiRef.w)*fw, y0+(p.y/poiRef.h)*fh with poiRef = detail-charts.json Epēshu 3914x4200; box per placement = tc-4 box verbatim (scale about the anchor 1236.1,1415 then +dx E). Overlay 2863x3072 vs poiRef aspect differ by 0.007% (~0.2 art px), ignored.
method.name_match: 13 pairs by name with the S7 drift folded by hand: the Marble Quarter=Marble Quarter, Fairy Arch=The Fairy Arch, the Thūkīn Amphitheater=Thūkīn Amphitheatre, rest identical. Excluded: sim templeName 'the Blue Temple of Thobrauk' (placed at runtime by the generator, not hand-placed) and 6 chart-only POIs (Temple of Thobrauk Tegendes, Temple of the Ēkromatkar, The Māmban, The Relkhonak, Black Barghest Inn, Road That Walks with the Sun).
method.chart_extent: overlay-Epeshu.jpg colour classes: sea = L1 to RGB(119,153,136) <36 and nearer than olive (tc dm_art rule), largest component; countryside = olive RGB(102,119,85) L1<40, opened 3x, components >=200k art px (in-town trees are the same olive but small); legend panel x2230-2837 y2046-3033 (detected by its navy border) excluded; urban footprint = the rest, opened, largest component, holes filled (it is cut by the frame on all four sides, so a lower bound). Built-up = urban pixels whose cream-ground fraction (RGB>=(230,220,170), R-B<70) in a 61 art px window, number badges masked, is <= 0.4/0.5/0.6; opened 3x, largest component, holes filled; touches no frame edge. Wall: the chart draws no wall circuit (visual inspection of the full overlay and two 800 px crops), so no wall radius exists to measure. r_eq = sqrt(area/pi). Art px to atlas px = box width/2863.
method.print_water: three-coasts-epeshu.json stores only r60 coast points, not the mask, so the mask was rebuilt by the same numpy port of buildCityMask on PIL-decoded z5 tiles over atlas [1040,1880)x[1220,2060); its coast reproduces the stored print_mask_edge to 0.15 px rms (869 vs 878 points within 60 px; max 1.58 tc->mine, 4.03 mine->tc). Signed distance: + inside print water, - on land (atlas px).
method.dem: EPESHU_HF_URI decoded with h=(R*256+G)/32-300 (decodeEpeshuHF), bilinear at the label grid position; raw decode (no genHydrology carving; Bangeph Rock's spike lift is applied at runtime by genTerrain and is not in these values).
method.scripts: throwaway numpy/scipy/PIL scripts in a mktemp dir; nothing under the repo was written.

direction_agreement_today.note: bearing (deg from N, clockwise) of each label from its own centre: sim from the sim centre, chart from the box centre at 1.0x. Scale and centre shift do not change chart bearings much, so this is near placement-independent.
direction_agreement_today.caveat: Epēshīn Forum (94 deg) is noise: its sim offset is 1.33 px.

labels_rms_radius.note: scale-only and immune to direction errors: ~1.0x (1.12 with all 13; 0.94 without Fairy Arch, which sits 41.5 px out in the sim vs 12.9 on the chart; median per-pair ratio 1.01)

lsq_context_only.note: all 13 chart POIs collapsed onto one point at the (shifted) anchor score 221-226 m rms; the per-name rms falls with smaller scale only because the two layouts disagree in direction, so least squares shrinks the chart toward a point (s 0.26-0.44). Not a policy signal.

scale_criteria.coast_tc4: 0.6x+3E best (3.58 rms to print), from gap-coasts:tc-4; quoted, not recomputed, not averaged

verdicts.labels: Per-name POI-to-sim-label rms is 265.5 m today (reproduces own-sim:S8: 103-489 m, median 190) and falls only to 209-235 m at the other six placements; collapsing all 13 chart POIs onto the anchor already scores 221-226 m. 4 meaningful pairs disagree in bearing by >90 deg (Outwall 166, Old Quarry Lot 151, Eelwynd 110, Thūkīn 101; Forum 94 is noise on a 1.3 px offset; median 53 deg). The sim labels do not share the chart layout, so no policy scale makes them line up: every placement leaves 5-6 labels >20 atlas px (~225 m) off. Per-name rms cannot choose the scale.
verdicts.labels_spread: Scale-only, direction-immune: the sim labels spread like the chart at ~1.0x today (rms-radius ratio 1.12 with all 13, 0.94 without Fairy Arch; median per-pair ratio 1.01), i.e. at the 1.0x end of the policy range.
verdicts.extent: The chart draws no wall. Its built-up area (r_eq 855-907 art px) is 14.5-15.4 atlas px at 1.0x = 0.62-0.65 of the sim disc R (23.52 px); 0.49-0.52 at 0.8x; 0.37-0.39 at 0.6x. The frame-cut urban footprint is 0.88/0.70/0.53. Built-up = R needs ~1.53-1.63x; built-up = the sim wall minimum 0.5R needs ~0.77-0.81x. At 0.6x the whole built-up chart fits inside the smallest wall circuit buildTownWall can draw.
verdicts.coast_vs_extent: Coast (tc-4) favours 0.6x+3E; sim extent and label spread favour >=1.0x. No single tc-4 placement satisfies both. Matching the chart built-up r_eq would need the sim capital R at ~167 m (1.0x), ~134 m (0.8x) or ~100 m (0.6x) instead of 265 m, plus the hand-placed labels pulled in by roughly the same factor; a 1.0x pick keeps the sim closest but carries the coast error tc-4 measured (8.48 -> 5.88-7.21 rms). Any pick therefore implies a later sim edit (rad, cityLabels, extraLandmarks: data-only, no RNG), cheapest before Street 1 freezes SV1-SV9; the sim streets are not dragged along.
verdicts.water: Projected chart POIs in print water: 10 of 19 today, 6 at 1.0x+3E, 5 at 1.0x+8E and 0.8x+3E, 4 at 0.8x+8E, 3 at 0.6x+3E, 1 at 0.6x+8E (Mount Mastery, a land hill, wet at every placement, 4.7-20.8 px). Shore-coded POIs cut the other way at 0.6x: Wood Quay lands 6.7-7.7 px inland (stronger signal); Bangeph Rock (a sea stack, chart sea) falls 1.5-2.5 px on print land, but that is inside tc-4's own 3.58 px residual and the print cannot show a stack at symbol scale (low confidence). Chart built-up on print water: 41% today, 29/14% at 1.0x+3E/+8E, 21/11% at 0.8x, 14/4% at 0.6x.
verdicts.sim_side_water: Independent of any placement, 5 sim labels sit in print water and 4 on DEM h<0: Mount Mastery (DEM -7.0 m, 6.0 px into print sea), Wood Quay (-5.4 m, 4.6 px), Eelwynd (-2.6 m, 3.6 px), Bangeph Rock (-5.8 m before its runtime spike, intended), Necropolis of the Founders (DEM +2.7 m but 2.0 px into print water).
